items.texto: In my opinion, / I believe that...
items.escena: A clay student standing up at a community meeting with one hand on her chest, calmly sharing her view while neighbours in folding chairs listen

items.texto: I am worried about / I am concerned about...
items.escena: A clay fisherman on a small wooden pier frowning, hand at his chin, as a huge cruise ship approaches his quiet little bay

items.texto: I strongly believe that... / I am not sure, but...
items.escena: Two clay students at a debate table: one leans forward pressing a fist firmly on the table with confidence, the other tilts her head with a small shrug and an open hand

items.texto: I see your point, but... / That's a good point, however...
items.escena: Two clay neighbours at a town meeting: one nods respectfully with a hand on the other's shoulder while raising a finger to add a different idea, both smiling

items.texto: From my point of view... / As I see it...
items.escena: A clay girl on a hilltop looking at a coastal town through binoculars, while a friend beside her views the same town from a rock at a different angle

items.texto: I prefer... to... / I would rather... than...
items.escena: A clay young woman in a coastal town street resting one hand on a bicycle and smiling, while a set of car keys lies ignored on a low wall beside her
A clay older neighbour gently pointing a young man toward a row of solar panels on a rooftop, with a kind, advising expression
Clay teenagers standing at the edge of a weedy vacant lot, one of them sketching in a notebook a small park with trees and benches that the lot might become
A clay man on a beach looking up at a sky that is half sunny and half cloudy, holding a folded umbrella with an uncertain expression
A clay neighbourhood street where every house has colourful recycling bins at its door, the air above clear and the river beside it sparkling clean
A clay car filling up at a fuel pump while thick grey smoke pours from its exhaust and a girl standing nearby covers her nose
A clay family installing solar panels on their roof: the father winces while handing over a big pile of coins, and the mother smiles at a glass savings jar slowly filling up
